global_boundary_certificate.proof_note: The old/new checked node sets are disjoint and their union is exactly all 8000 nodes. Their source canonical/pressure fingerprints agree with the current exact arrays, and their boundary model constants agree. Every actual merged ZZLD record has the certified SHA256 of its first 24 semantic index bytes (node/res/origin/dimensions/island-count/reserved; payload offset is intentionally excluded) and its complete payload. The merged planet float32 coordinate frames match every certified frame. Every level is safe, with no crossing/uncertified cell, including positive-small-circle full-cell and float32 rounding bounds. Both disjoint audits checked all 7999 other canonical nodes; hence each complete occupied cell is in its common unshrunk pairwise half-domain and different groups cannot have strictly overlapping pre-camera radial footprints. This is a pure-data certificate; no renderer/camera-transform or actual fine geometry behavior is inferred.
global_boundary_certificate.scope: actual renderer-solid land_u8>=128 full-cell radial footprints before camera/screen transforms; all 8000 nodes each checked against all 7999 canonical neighbours, not all-planet GPU pixel inspection
